newsitem.title: USA: SmarTalk in pact with HFS Inc.
newsitem.headline: SmarTalk in pact with HFS Inc.

text.p: SmarTalk Teleservices Inc said Friday it has an agreement with HFS Inc allowing it to market its prepaid, long distance calling card products to more than 7,800 properties in the United States.

The five-year exclusive agreement allows SmarTalk access to the franchisees of the Avis, Days Inn, Ramada, Howard Johnson, Knights Inn, Super 8, Travelodge, Villager Lodge, Wingate Inn systems and the resort owners affiliated with Resort Condominiums International Inc for the sale of prepaid long-distance calling card products.
The agreement also allows SmarTalk to sell through ATM machines located at the properties and to provide cards for incentive marketing programs including those targeting frequent travelers.
Market testing of various brand programs will begin during fourth quarter of 1997, with program roll-out starting in 1998, the company said.
SmarTalk manufactures and distributes prepaid calling cards and other telecommunications products.
